name: bp-collector
description: Fetches one source's mentions for one brand and one time window, within a credit ceiling.

skills.name: Collect one source
skills.description: Runs one source's Anakin adapter over a half-open window, drops mentions the brand already has, and returns a MentionBatch with the credits it spent. Stops at max_credits and marks the batch truncated rather than overspending.
examples: Collect reddit mentions for boat-lifestyle between 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-20 within 40 credits.
